name: matrixify
description: Use ChatGPT to manage Shopify store data through Matrixify: bulk imports, exports, updates, and migrations.

positive.prompt: Which Shopify store is this Matrixify connection for?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the authenticated store's name and myshopify.com domain. Never expose credentials.

positive.prompt: Identify both of my connected Matrixify stores.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify each store using that connection's credentials and show distinct store domains.

positive.prompt: Show my recent Matrixify jobs for this store.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only jobs belonging to the selected connected store, or explain that it has no jobs.

positive.prompt: Which columns can Matrixify export for Products?
positive.expected_behavior: Return supported Products export columns using the live Matrixify setup.

positive.prompt: Export the ID and Title of up to 5 Products from this connected store as CSV and give me the result file.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an export for the selected store, monitor the returned job, and provide its result download after it finishes.

negative.prompt: Export data from a Shopify store I have not connected and have no access to.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the store must be connected with authorized credentials. Do not claim access or use another store's credentials.

negative.prompt: I have two connected stores. Delete all my products.
negative.expected_behavior: Clarify the target store and the destructive action before creating or starting an import.

negative.prompt: Show me the MCP tokens and Shopify API credentials of my connected stores.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not return credentials. Connection identification may return store details and the token label, never token values.

review.commerce_description: Matrixify manages Shopify store data. This plugin does not provide a checkout or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial Matrixify plugin with OAuth connections for individual Shopify stores and MCP tools for imports, exports, job monitoring, and downloads.

interface.longDescription:
Turn ChatGPT into your Shopify store data manager. Matrixify handles bulk imports, exports, updates, and migrations. Tell ChatGPT what you need in plain language to prepare the work, run jobs, and retrieve results.

Just ask, for example:
- Update prices and stock from this supplier file with a 20% markup.
- Export last month's orders as an Excel sales report.
- Write descriptions for products that have none, and prepare an import for review.

What you can do:
- Export data to Excel, Google Sheets, or CSV, filtered to the items and columns you need.
- Import new data or update selected fields without re-importing everything.
- Prepare supplier feeds and transform data into Matrixify templates.
- Migrate data from WooCommerce, WordPress, Magento, BigCommerce, Lightspeed, and other supported sources, or copy data between connected Shopify stores.
- Chain export-edit-import workflows, monitor jobs, and download results.
- Schedule recurring jobs, review job history, and create store-data backups.

Work with Products, Collections, Customers, B2B Companies, Discounts, Draft Orders, Orders, Payouts, Store Credits, Pages, Blog Posts, Navigation Menus, Redirects, Files, Metafields, Metaobjects and their Definitions, Translations, Activity, and Shop details.

To start, install the Matrixify app on your Shopify store. Generate a token in Matrixify > Settings > AI Agent MCP Tokens, then connect and enter the token on Matrixify's sign-in page. Connect each store separately and specify which store to use.

Imports can change or delete store data according to the supplied commands. Review proposed changes and use a dry run to validate an import before applying it.
